gold_decisions.identity_explanation: Both entries identify the same abstract-level scope error: the universal claim that every listed criterion is NP-hard and admits no PTAS contradicts the polynomial-time Frobenius case and extends the no-PTAS conclusion beyond the criteria actually established. Both also identify the appropriate abstract-only scope correction.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The abstract overclaims universal NP-hardness/no-PTAS results across all listed criteria, despite an exact polynomial-time Frobenius algorithm and missing no-PTAS results for several other listed criteria.

component_coverage.gold_component: The abstract makes a universal no-PTAS claim that contradicts the exact polynomial-time Frobenius-norm case and overstates the established scope for other criteria.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-001 explicitly identifies the universal abstract claim, the polynomial-time Frobenius exception, the criteria lacking established no-PTAS results, the overstated effect, and a precise scope-rewording repair. No substantive gold concern remains unrecognised.
